headline: Rocket Lab delays first Neutron rocket launch to 2027
summary: Rocket Lab pushed back the first launch of its Neutron rocket to 2027 due to problems with carbon composite materials; the rocket was announced in 2021 with an original target of a 2024 first flight.

claims.statement: Rocket Lab pushed back the first Neutron launch to 2027 due to carbon composite problems.
